name: Open Warehouse Requests
query:
SELECT
    u.full_name AS "Full Name",
    wr.owner_name,
    wr.status,
    wr.warehouse_request_name AS "Warehouse Request Name",
    wr.due_date AS "Due Date",
    SUM(CASE WHEN wr.request_reason = '--None--' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 'None Count',
    SUM(CASE WHEN wr.request_reason = 'Product Testing' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 'Product Testing Count',
    SUM(CASE WHEN wr.request_reason = 'Build Machine' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 'Build Machine Count',
    SUM(CASE WHEN wr.request_reason = 'Build Locker' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Build_Locker_Count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN wr.request_reason = 'Build Kiosk' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Build_Kiosk_Count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN wr.request_reason = 'Build Vault' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Build_Vault_Count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN wr.request_reason = 'Wrap Ready' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Wrap_Ready_Count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN wr.request_reason = 'Print Labels' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Print_Labels_Count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN wr.request_reason = 'Device Request' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Device_Request_Count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN wr.request_reason = 'Shipping Request' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Shipping_Request_Count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN wr.request_reason = 'Reader Request' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Reader_Request_Count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN wr.request_reason = 'Transport/Relocate Equipment' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Transport_Relocate_Equipment_Count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN wr.request_reason = 'Shipping Quote' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Shipping_Quote_Count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN wr.request_reason = 'Other' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Other_Count
FROM
    `tabWarehouse Request` wr
LEFT JOIN
    `tabUser` u ON wr.owner_name = u.email
WHERE
    wr.status IN ('New', 'In Progress', 'Pending')
GROUP BY
    "User Full Name", wr.owner_name, wr.status, wr.warehouse_request_name, wr.due_date;
